ID_S1_SELECT_SIDE_CONFIRMATION: Are you sure? Faction can't be changed later. This selection will affect the entirety of "The Last Jedi" and what content you can unlock during this event.
ID_S1_SELECT_SIDE_DESCRIPTION:
Align with the First Order or choose to fight for the Resistance. 
Supporting a faction will give you six unique challenges during The Last Jedi season. 
Earn greater rewards if your faction emerges victorious.
ID_S1_SELECT_SIDE_DISCLAIMER:
Complete The Last Jedi challenges to help your faction win the season and earn special rewards.
Your Pledge lasts for the first season only. All content will still be available to you in-game.
